title: Step 3: Pick Things Up
story: Rooms hold items: a lamp in the hut, a key in the market.
goal: Add pick(room, bag): if the room has an item that is not in the bag yet, return a NEW bag that includes it; otherwise return the bag unchanged.
hints: ROOMS[room]["item"] is None when the room is empty.
Check that the item exists and is not already in the bag. bag + [item] builds a new list.
socratic: What if you take twice in the same room?
Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: how does this checkpoint build on the last one?
